title: pathosd
description: pathosd — BGP-based VIP health checker and route manager

panels.title: VIP State
panels.description: Current state of each VIP: 0=withdrawn, 1=announced, 2=pessimized

panels.title: Time Since Last Transition
panels.description: Seconds since the last VIP state change

panels.title: Check Last Result
panels.description: Last health check result per VIP (0=fail, 1=success)

panels.title: VIP State Over Time
panels.description: VIP state over time (0=withdrawn, 1=announced, 2=pessimized)

panels.title: VIP Priority (AS-path prepend multiplier)
panels.description: AS-path prepend count applied to the route: announce.as_path_prepend while announced, plus lower_priority.as_path_prepend while pessimized (0 = full priority)

panels.title: VIP Transitions
panels.description: Rate of VIP state transitions per second

panels.title: Route State
panels.description: Per-peer per-VIP route advertisement state (1=advertised, 0=withdrawn)

panels.title: Route State Over Time
panels.description: Route advertisement state over time

panels.title: Check Rate
panels.description: Health check executions per second by result

panels.title: Check Success Rate
panels.description: Fraction of health checks that succeeded

panels.title: Check Duration Heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of health check durations

panels.title: Check Duration (avg)
panels.description: Average health check duration per VIP and type

panels.title: Timeout Exceeded
panels.description: Rate of checks exceeding their configured timeout

panels.title: BGP Peer Session State
panels.description: BGP FSM session state per peer (1 = Established)

panels.title: BGP Peer Uptime
panels.description: How long the peer has been in its current state

panels.title: BGP Peer Flops
panels.description: Total number of BGP session flaps per peer

panels.title: BGP Out Queue
panels.description: Outgoing message queue depth per peer

panels.title: Routes Received / Accepted / Advertised
panels.description: Number of BGP routes per peer and address family

panels.title: BGP Messages Received
panels.description: BGP messages received per second by type

panels.title: BGP Messages Sent
panels.description: BGP messages sent per second by type

panels.title: BGP Withdraw Rate
panels.description: BGP withdraw messages per second

panels.title: BGP Discarded Messages
panels.description: Discarded BGP messages per second

panels.title: FSM Loop Timing
panels.description: Average FSM loop processing time per operation type

panels.title: FSM Loop Wait Time
panels.description: Average FSM channel delay (time waiting in queue)

panels.title: HTTP Response Status
panels.description: Status code of the last HTTP check response

panels.title: TLS Certificate Expires In
panels.description: Time until NotAfter of the leaf certificate seen by the last HTTPS check

panels.title: gRPC Status Code
panels.description: gRPC status code of the last check call (0 = OK)

panels.title: Ping RTT
panels.description: Distribution of ICMP echo round-trip times

panels.title: Ping Packet Loss
panels.description: Packet loss of the last ping run per VIP

panels.title: DNS Answers
panels.description: Answer records in the last DNS reply per queried name

panels.title: DNS Response Code
panels.description: rcode of the last DNS reply per queried name (0 = NOERROR, 2 = SERVFAIL, 3 = NXDOMAIN)

panels.title: Listen Sockets
panels.description: Sockets bound to the checked port in the last listen check (0 = nothing listening)
